# PhoenixKitProjects v0.16.0 - Table of Contents

> Projects module for PhoenixKit — projects, reusable tasks, assignments, and dependencies.

## Modules

- [PhoenixKitProjects](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.md): Projects module for PhoenixKit.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.AITranslatable](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.AITranslatable.md): `PhoenixKitAI.Translatable` adapter for projects resources —
the small per-module hook into PhoenixKitAI's generic AI-translation pipeline.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.AITranslateBinding](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.AITranslateBinding.md): `PhoenixKitAI.Components.AITranslate.FormBinding` for projects forms — the
storage-specific half of the shared AI-translate glue.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Activity](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Activity.md): Activity logging wrapper for the Projects module.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.CalendarDisplay](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.CalendarDisplay.md): Maps projects to `PhoenixLiveCalendar.Event` structs for the Overview
dashboard calendar.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Errors](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Errors.md): Atom → translated-string dispatcher for Projects context errors.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.GanttDisplay](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.GanttDisplay.md): Global display settings for the projects Gantt/Timeline chart.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Gettext](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Gettext.md): Gettext backend for projects-module-specific UI strings.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.L10n](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.L10n.md): Tiny locale-aware date/time formatting helpers used by the projects UI.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Paths](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Paths.md): Centralized path helpers for the Projects module.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Projects](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Projects.md): Context for projects, tasks, assignments, and dependencies.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.PubSub](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.PubSub.md): Real-time updates for the projects module, backed by
`PhoenixKit.PubSub.Manager`.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Schemas.Assignment](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Schemas.Assignment.md): A task instance within a project. Copies description and duration from
the task template at creation time — editable independently.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Schemas.Dependency](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Schemas.Dependency.md): A dependency link: `assignment_uuid` cannot start until `depends_on_uuid`
is done. Both must be in the same project (enforced at the context layer).

- [PhoenixKitProjects.Schemas.Project](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Schemas.Project.md): A project container. Can start immediately (set up tasks first, then
mark as started) or be scheduled for a future date.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Schemas.ProjectStatus](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Schemas.ProjectStatus.md): A project's **cemented** workflow status — a local snapshot of a catalog
status row, copied from the `phoenix_kit_entities` vocabulary when the
project starts.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Schemas.Task](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Schemas.Task.md): Reusable task template with title, description, estimated duration,
and optional default assignee.

- [PhoenixKitProjects.Schemas.TaskDependency](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Schemas.TaskDependency.md): Default dependency between task templates. When both tasks are added
to the same project, the assignment dependency is auto-created.

- [PhoenixKitProjects.Statuses](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Statuses.md): User-defined project **workflow statuses**, configured through the
optional `phoenix_kit_entities` module and cemented locally when a
project starts.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.AssignmentFormLive](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.AssignmentFormLive.md): Add a task to a project or edit an existing assignment.
Supports picking from library or creating new. Manages assignment
dependencies (which tasks in this project must finish first).

- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.md): Aggregator for the projects module's reusable UI components.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.AssignmentStatusBadge](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.AssignmentStatusBadge.md): Status presentation for an `Assignment.status` value (`"todo"`,
`"in_progress"`, `"done"`). Mirrors `DerivedStatusBadge` but for the
assignment lifecycle instead of the project lifecycle.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.DerivedStatusBadge](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.DerivedStatusBadge.md): Badge that renders a project's `Project.derived_status/1` value as
a daisyUI badge with the canonical icon + color + gettext'd label.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.PageHeader](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.PageHeader.md): Section heading + description + action button row used by every
admin LV in the projects module (Overview, Projects list, Tasks,
Templates, Project show, every form).
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.PopupHost](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.PopupHost.md): Layered daisyUI `<dialog>` modal stack driven by a `modal_stack`
assign. The function component renders the always-visible content
(default slot) plus one `<dialog>` per stack frame, delegating each
frame's body rendering to the `:frame` slot the host provides.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.RunningCard](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.RunningCard.md): One project in the dashboard's "Running" section, rendered as a **hierarchical
summary** (V127): a top line with the project name + tier + progress, a
one-line summary (`N tasks · M sub-projects`), a status breakdown
(`X done · Y in progress · Z todo`), and then each embedded sub-project nested
underneath as an indented sub-step with its own summary + breakdown — all the
way down.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.SmartLink](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.SmartLink.md): Embed-mode aware link.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.SmartMenuLink](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.SmartMenuLink.md): Embed-mode aware `<li>` entry for use inside `<.table_row_menu>`.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.StatTile](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.StatTile.md): Compact bordered card with a label and a big number. Used in
OverviewLive's top stats row (Running / Tasks in progress / Tasks
todo / Tasks done) and in the bottom navigation row.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.TabsStrip](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.TabsStrip.md): daisyUI `tabs tabs-boxed` segment switcher driven by the active
value + a list of `{value, label, icon}` tuples. Used in
`AssignmentFormLive` ("From library" / "Create new") and ready
for reuse anywhere a small set of mutually-exclusive panes shares
a single LV-managed assign.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.TierPill](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.TierPill.md): Status pill rendered next to a project title on the Running
dashboard. Encodes the prioritized-tier classification
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.WorkflowStatusFields](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Components.WorkflowStatusFields.md): The shared "Workflow status" form section (V125), reused by every form that
edits a project-like record: `ProjectFormLive`, `TemplateFormLive`, and
`AssignmentFormLive`'s sub-project mode. A sub-project and a template are both
projects, so they get the same status-source picker a project has.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Helpers](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.Helpers.md): Cross-cutting helpers for the projects module's LiveView layer.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.OverviewLive](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.OverviewLive.md): Projects module dashboard.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.PopupHostLive](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.PopupHostLive.md): Opinionated wrapper LV that pairs the `<.popup_host>` function
component with the emit-mode PubSub contract.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.ProjectFormLive](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.ProjectFormLive.md): Create or edit a project.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.ProjectGanttLive](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.ProjectGanttLive.md): Gantt / waterfall view of a project — the same data as
`ProjectShowLive`, rendered as horizontal bars on a date axis via the
`PhoenixLiveGantt` component instead of the vertical timeline.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.ProjectShowLive](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.ProjectShowLive.md): Show a project with a vertical timeline of assignments.
Supports inline status changes, duration editing, dependency
management, and tracks who completed each task.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.ProjectsLive](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.ProjectsLive.md): List projects.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.ProjectsSettingsLive](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.ProjectsSettingsLive.md): Projects module settings (global, under the core Settings area).
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.TaskFormLive](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.TaskFormLive.md): Create or edit a reusable task template, including default dependencies.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.TasksLive](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.TasksLive.md): List reusable task templates.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.TemplateFormLive](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.TemplateFormLive.md): Create or edit a project template.
- [PhoenixKitProjects.Web.TemplatesLive](https://phoenix-kit-projects.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitProjects.Web.TemplatesLive.md): List project templates.
